records.rule: Social media is mediated publish/receive/share/reply/recommend/discuss, not a list of consumer networks.
Key surfaces by provider/family/resource/visibility, and items by surface plus item ID.
A provider feature, even if real, is not an account/surface/action grant.
Strict scoped facade is currently opt-in; lower-level public service exposure remains a production bypass risk.
Signed or otherwise verified inbound envelope proof must be bound to normalized content; mutable metadata alone is not evidence.
An existing matching request ID returns the existing receipt; altered request body under that ID is an error.
An uncertain remote dispatch requires proof-based reconciliation, never an automatic repost.
File-append dev journal checks are not fsync/multiwriter crash durability.
Queued or accepted means an acknowledgment, not verified delivery or consumer impact.
CMS/Story publish meaning and intention, social projects events, Brand Interaction evaluates effects; no layer inherits approval.
A paid-placement proposal cannot authorize spending or imply a ChatGPT ads purchasing API.
Steam, Discord, YouTube, marketplace and email group profiles are examples; no live adapter in dev6.
The dev6 exact source package is static-qualified here, not interpreter-qualified or Autobuild-accepted by that fact.
Structural facade enforcement, durable journal, and an authenticated real provider are gates before production.
